nodes.rationale: When important resistance breaks with above-average volume, shorts cover and longs chase, generating price expansion.

nodes.label: Small Caps Market Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: Long strategies are framed around small-cap floats, low liquidity, dilution risk, and often ephemeral catalysts.

nodes.label: Small Caps Extension Destruction Rebound Cycle
nodes.rationale: The document models small caps as cycling from dormancy to volume-driven extension, destruction, rebound, and dormancy again.
nodes.norm_label: small caps extension destruction rebound cycle

nodes.label: Volume Direction Signal
nodes.rationale: The document treats increasing volume as directional confirmation and decreasing volume as exhaustion or a reversal setup condition.

nodes.label: Timing Precision
nodes.rationale: The playbook stresses that each pattern has an exact entry point and should not be chased after that point is missed.

nodes.label: Buy Weakness Sell Strength
nodes.rationale: The operational guidance is to buy on weakness and sell into strength within confirmed long structures.

nodes.label: Capital Preservation
nodes.rationale: The document states that preserving capital is more important than any single gain.

nodes.label: Short Plays
nodes.rationale: Short plays focus on exhaustion, rejection, and reversal patterns in overextended small-cap stocks.

nodes.label: Overextension
nodes.source_location: ## 2. Criterios principales para abrir shorts / Sobreextension
nodes.rationale: The document states that without overextension a short should not be opened, with a preferred minimum of 50-60 percent upside from the start of the run.

nodes.source_location: ## 2. Criterios principales para abrir shorts / Float adecuado
nodes.rationale: Micro-floats under five million shares are described as difficult to control and prone to squeezes.

nodes.label: First Red Day
nodes.rationale: First Red Day is presented as the first sign of exhaustion after a multi-day green run and as an essential short-side concept.

nodes.label: Decreasing Volume

nodes.label: Overextended Gap Down
nodes.rationale: The document identifies this as a gap-down pattern in an extremely overextended stock and the only pattern where frontside shorting can be done with conviction while respecting previous close resistance.

nodes.label: Frontside Short
nodes.source_location: ### 3.2 Overextended Gap Down (OGD); ### 3.3 Short into Resistance (SIR); ## 7. Glosario tecnico breve

nodes.label: Late Day Fade
nodes.rationale: Late Day Fade is described as one of the clearest but most difficult short setups, requiring discipline and avoiding early shorts against strong first green days.

nodes.label: All Day Fade
nodes.source_location: ### 4.2 Gap and Extension (Stuff Move); ## 7. Glosario tecnico breve

nodes.label: Gap-Up Overnight Risk
nodes.rationale: Holding a short from the first red day close is described as extremely risky because a later gap up can cause losses above 100 percent.

nodes.label: Loss of Market Interest
nodes.rationale: The stated goal is not to guess the top but to recognize when the market loses interest.

nodes.label: Big Picture Discipline
nodes.rationale: Consistency is attributed to respecting the larger setup and not forcing anticipations.

nodes.label: All-Time High Avoidance
nodes.source_location: ## 2. Criterios principales para abrir shorts / Overhead resistance
nodes.rationale: The document prefers visible overhead resistance and says the stock should not be at all-time highs.

nodes.label: Day Trading en Small Caps: Teoria y Playbook
nodes.author: Xavi
nodes.norm_label: day trading en small caps: teoria y playbook

nodes.label: Structural Cash Need
nodes.author: Xavi
nodes.rationale: Small-cap companies with recurring losses must raise capital, creating a persistent incentive to sell new shares into liquidity.

nodes.label: Long Imbalance Model
nodes.author: Xavi
nodes.rationale: A long trade needs demand to exceed supply through a strong catalyst, favorable price action, possible short covering, and limited sellers.

nodes.label: Short Imbalance Model
nodes.author: Xavi
nodes.rationale: A short trade seeks exhausted demand and heavier supply from extension, weak catalysts, dilution, overhead resistance, or insider/institutional selling.

nodes.label: Risk Management
nodes.author: Xavi
nodes.rationale: Daily loss controls, setup quality, and sizing discipline prevent ruin, revenge trading, and emotional escalation.

nodes.label: Watchlist Construction
nodes.author: Xavi
nodes.rationale: The trader balances float, volume, price action, news, extension, statistics, dilution, sector, insiders, and country to decide which side to trade.

nodes.label: Journaling
nodes.author: Xavi
nodes.rationale: Trade review turns executions, mistakes, emotions, and setup tags into repeatable improvement.

nodes.label: Scalability Process
nodes.author: Xavi
nodes.rationale: Scaling comes after consistency, representative trade data, controlled drawdowns, and increased size only in proven strengths.

nodes.label: Broker Firebreaks
nodes.author: Xavi
nodes.rationale: Buying-power, autoliquidation, dollar-amount, and share limits are external guardrails against operational mistakes.
